question:
The table given below shows the number of runs scored and number of balls played by 5 batsmen.

 No. of runs scored

 P
 70

 80
 60

 90
 50

 110
 160
 
 

 T
 40
 40
 
 

Strike rate = (Number of runs scored )/(Number of balls played) × 100

Which of the batsman has the highest strike rate?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The strike rate of P is (70/25) × 100 = 280

The strike rate of Q is (80/ 60) × 100 = 133.3.

The strike rate of R is (90/ 50) × 100 = 180

The strike rate of S is (110/160) × 100 = 68.75

**P has the highest strike rate.**
